Title: Execute baseline call exactly as captured
Expected Result: Executes without error. Returns open (IsOpenActivity=1) activities tagged with tag 6737 (BSP) that user 285 / role 346314 can see, excluding child and reference element tasks. Record the row count; later cases compare against it.

Title: Re-execute baseline call (repeatability)
Expected Result: Same rows, same column set, and same order as TC001. Proves the result is deterministic.

Title: Empty @FilterTags TVP
Expected Result: No error. Either no tag filter is applied (rows >= TC001) or zero rows are returned; confirm which behaviour is intended against the procedure definition.

Title: Two tags in @FilterTags
Expected Result: Rows for tag 6737 OR tag $(AltTagID). Row count >= TC001. No duplicate activity rows.

Title: Non-existent tag ID (-1)
Expected Result: No error, zero rows.

Title: Same tag supplied twice
Expected Result: Identical to TC001. Activities are not duplicated by the repeated tag. (If the TVP has a primary key, the duplicate INSERT fails; that is also acceptable.)

Title: IsOpenActivity = 0
Expected Result: Returns closed/completed activities only (or all activities, per the definition). No activity is in both the TC001 and TC020 results if 0 means closed.

Title: IsOpenActivity = NULL
Expected Result: No error. Expected: open and closed activities (row count >= TC001).

Title: IsChildElementTasks = 1
Expected Result: Child element tasks are included. Row count >= TC001.

Title: IsReferenceElementTasks = 1
Expected Result: Reference element tasks are included. Row count >= TC001.

Title: IsChildElementTasks = 1 and IsReferenceElementTasks = 1
Expected Result: Child and reference tasks are both included. Rows >= max(TC030, TC031). No duplicates.

Title: IsChildElementTasks = NULL and IsReferenceElementTasks = NULL
Expected Result: No error. Behaves the same as 0, or as the defaults documented in the procedure.

Title: IsMobileEnabled = 1
Expected Result: Only activities whose process is mobile-enabled. Subset of TC001.

Title: IsMobileEnabled = 0
Expected Result: Only activities that are not mobile-enabled (or no filter). TC040 + TC041 should equal TC001.

Title: IsPersistentDataRequired = 1
Expected Result: Persistent data columns or result set are returned and populated. Activity rows match TC001.

Title: IsPersistentDataRequired = 0
Expected Result: Same as TC001 (NULL and 0 behave the same).

Title: ProcessTitle = 0
Expected Result: No error. Process title column or result set is omitted or changed per the definition. Activity rows match TC001.

Title: ProcessTitle = NULL
Expected Result: No error. Behaves the same as 0 or as the default.

Title: StartDate only
Expected Result: Only activities whose date (per ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo=1) is on or after $(StartDate).

Title: EndDate only
Expected Result: Only activities whose date is on or before $(EndDate).

Title: StartDate and EndDate (valid range)
Expected Result: Only activities within [$(StartDate), $(EndDate)]. This is the intersection of TC060 and TC061.

Title: StartDate later than EndDate
Expected Result: No error, zero rows (or a meaningful validation error if the procedure validates the range).

Title: StartDate = EndDate (single day)
Expected Result: Includes activities at any time on that day. Watch for a time-portion bug where EndDate midnight excludes the rest of the day.

Title: Widest range (1900-01-01 to 9999-12-31)
Expected Result: No overflow error. Same rows as TC001.

Title: ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo = 2 with date range
Expected Result: The date range is applied to the alternative date column (e.g. due date instead of start date).

Title: ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo = 0 with date range
Expected Result: No error. Either the date filter is ignored or a defined default applies.

Title: ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo = NULL with date range
Expected Result: No error. Either the date filter is ignored or a defined default applies.

Title: ProcessDateFilterAppliesTo = 99 (invalid)
Expected Result: Either a handled validation error or zero rows / no date filter. Must not be an unhandled crash.

Title: @ProcessStatus with one valid value
Expected Result: Only activities whose process status = $(StatusValue). Subset of TC001.

Title: @ProcessStatus with two values
Expected Result: Activities with status $(StatusValue) OR $(AltStatusValue). Rows >= TC070.

Title: @ProcessStatus with non-existent value (-1)
Expected Result: No error, zero rows.

Title: @ProcessPriorities with one valid value
Expected Result: Only activities whose process priority = $(PriorityValue). Subset of TC001.

Title: @ProcessPriorities with two values
Expected Result: Activities with priority $(PriorityValue) OR $(AltPriorityValue). Rows >= TC075.

Title: @ProcessPriorities with non-existent value (-1)
Expected Result: No error, zero rows.

Title: @ProcessTypes with one valid value
Expected Result: Only activities whose process type = $(TypeValue). Subset of TC001.

Title: @ProcessTypes with two values
Expected Result: Activities with type $(TypeValue) OR $(AltTypeValue). Rows >= TC080.

Title: @ProcessTypes with non-existent value (-1)
Expected Result: No error, zero rows.

Title: @ProcessTriggers with one valid value
Expected Result: Only activities whose process trigger = $(TriggerValue). Subset of TC001.

Title: @ProcessTriggers with two values
Expected Result: Activities with trigger $(TriggerValue) OR $(AltTriggerValue). Rows >= TC085.

Title: @ProcessTriggers with non-existent value (-1)
Expected Result: No error, zero rows.

Title: Omit all four filter-value TVP parameters
Expected Result: Omitted TVPs default to empty, so the result equals TC001.

Title: Non-existent UserID (999999999)
Expected Result: No error, zero rows. Must not leak other users' activities.

Title: UserID = NULL
Expected Result: Zero rows or a handled validation error. Must never return every user's activities.

Title: UserID = 0
Expected Result: No error, zero rows.

Title: Non-existent RoleID (-1)
Expected Result: No error. Zero rows, or only activities assigned directly to the user rather than a role.

Title: RoleID = NULL
Expected Result: Zero rows or user-only activities, or a handled validation error.

Title: Valid role the user is NOT a member of
Expected Result: Must not return the role's activities to user 285 (authorisation check).

Title: Omit @UserID
Expected Result: Error 201 ('expects parameter @UserID') if the parameter has no default; otherwise the documented default.

Title: Valid ParentProcessInstanceID
Expected Result: Only activities of child processes of instance $(ParentProcessInstanceID).

Title: Non-existent ParentProcessInstanceID (-1)
Expected Result: No error, zero rows.

Title: ParentProcessInstanceID = NULL
Expected Result: No error. Same as 0 (no parent filter).

Title: All filters applied together
Expected Result: Rows satisfy every filter at once. This is a subset of each single-filter case (TC060-TC062, TC070, TC075, TC080, TC085).

Title: All optional bit flags = 1
Expected Result: No error. Includes child and reference tasks, mobile-enabled only, with persistent data.

Title: All nullable parameters NULL
Expected Result: Zero rows or a handled validation error. No unhandled error and no unfiltered data leak.

Title: Baseline call within time budget
Expected Result: Completes within $(MaxDurationMs) ms on a warm cache.

Title: @FilterTags with 500 rows
Expected Result: No error. Completes within $(MaxDurationMs) ms. No tempdb spill or plan regression.

Title: Widest date range with child + reference tasks
Expected Result: Completes within $(MaxDurationMs) ms with the largest realistic result set.
